notes: Independent implementation: normalized Parquet and exported result files only; Go edge/counter shards are not read.
Core requires both is_xpac=false and quality_null_xpac=false; pre-2000 cited works remain in Q.
Citation year is citing publication year (2000..2026), both endpoints in Q, repeated references deduplicated, same-work loops excluded; author self-citations retained.

Annual fractional conservation includes UNKNOWN at every layer; all 216 ECI/PCI models additionally undergo independent RCA/M and nonsymmetric-operator numerical checks from the main cube. Shares are not fully recomputed cell by cell.
Nine independently weighted cells: CN/US/GB x Topics Fields 17/11 and Concepts Level 0 Biology, threshold .3 with within-level deduplication and uniform fractions.
One complete reference join emits annual edge counts and all representative target weights together. Hash verification also reads source bytes but performs no citation computation.

Cache contents are SHA256 verified before SQL; source size/mtime is checked again afterwards. Inputs are trusted immutable artifacts, not protected against deliberate same-size/same-mtime concurrent mutation.
